summary: Implementation conforms to the saved plan. The worker now has an interval-gated classified-orphan cleanup loop wired into run_once, gated by auto_cleanup_orphans, with transient DB warning/reschedule and non-transient failure logging/reschedule reason codes. Production service wiring passes a classified reaper callback, Docker host, work dir, compose teardown closure, min age, and the new classified_orphan_reap_scan_interval_seconds setting. orphan_resources adds sweep_classified_orphans to scan Docker resources and managed worktrees, load workspace classification, build the summary, and call reap_classified_orphans while preserving skip-on-unavailable semantics and reaper reason codes. Focused tests cover flag-off no-fire, flag-on firing/reschedule, transient/fatal loop errors, run_once invocation, config flow, production callback wiring, and classified Docker/worktree reap plus DB-unavailable skip. Existing validation evidence in plans/CLASSIFIED_ORPHAN_REAPER_VALIDATION.md reports the focused pytest, ruff, and mypy checks passing; full AWF/GitHub validation and coverage are intentionally left to the AWF validation phase per the workspace contract. Scope boundaries were honored: auth_mounts.py and gc.py were not touched.
